functional_requirements.requirement: Load operational universe only through current universe pointer
Load scoring only through current scoring pointer contract
Fail closed and render catalog fallback on any scoring check failure
Never auto-load the v2.25B diagnostic artifact
Require explicit diagnostic acknowledgement per session
Hide dry_run_rank, top/bottom and score sorting in diagnostic mode
Search by name, ticker and ISIN
Filter country, exchange/MIC, currency, asset type, provider and metadata quality
Paginate/virtualize the 43,089-row catalog
Preserve unknown metadata as explicit filter values
Open an asset detail without losing filter context
Create, load, rename and describe watchlists
Add asset using stable identity and prevent duplicates
Reject ambiguous ticker selection until exchange is chosen
Support CSV watchlist import with row-level result summary
Support tags, notes, remove, archive and validation
Export injection-safe watchlist CSV
Generate universe and watchlist reports in Markdown/HTML
Create and expose provenance manifest for every report
Show export pack catalog and distinguish design/implemented/blocked
Show current provider 13/14 and 2,013-row maintenance gap
Show pointer/dataset hashes in an expandable provenance panel
Keep maintenance actions read-only unless an explicit gate workflow is entered
Provide Spanish UI copy with stable technical identifiers
Offer a persistent 'No es asesoramiento financiero' disclosure
Do not expose broker actions, buy/sell signals or allocations
Do not run OpenAI, yfinance, provider fetches or pipeline jobs on initial page load
Cache pointer-safe reads with source hash as cache key
Expose human-readable errors without stack traces or secrets
Keep existing CLI tools usable independently of UI

nonfunctional_requirements.target: Core catalog/watchlist/report workflow works without network
Initial status view usable within 3 seconds on reference machine after warm cache
Typical catalog filter response below 1 second after load
Avoid duplicate full-dataframe copies; target below 1 GB for catalog workflow
Keyboard navigation, visible focus, semantic labels, non-color status cues
WCAG AA contrast for text and controls
SHA/pointer validation before score or maintenance-derived views
Watchlist writes retain backup and never corrupt existing JSON
No credentials, environment values, stack traces or unsafe HTML in UI
Stable identity and final tie/order rules
Every generated artifact records source and output hashes
Data adapters and UI state functions independently testable
Remove Google Fonts dependency or provide system-font fallback for offline use
